edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) in cleared funds within ten business days after this Agreement has been executed by both parties, by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or claims to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal, tax, financial, and other professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations, or as required by applicable law, regulation, or court order. Where legally permitted, a party required to disclose shall give the other party reasonable advance notice and limit disclosure to what is required.

receiver.message_back: The narrowed, payment-conditioned release and confidentiality exceptions are acceptable in principle; please provide your client’s best monetary offer, as no settlement can be agreed while the Settlement Amount remains open. We propose payment within five business days after execution, with Plaintiff retaining all underlying claims until full cleared payment and the right to enforce the payment obligation if overdue, without double recovery.
